# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 20 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 20:2 — tree of mercy — central symbol

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the tree of mercy will spring from these branches" | Literal de his ramis germinabit |
| LOGOS | "the tree of mercy will grow" | Natural English |
| PNEUMA | "the tree of mercy will grow" | Same |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS/PNEUMA agree: 'will grow.' Natural English; preserves the essential imagery. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
